detailed_sections.full_notes: Part III of the Indian Constitution guarantees Fundamental Rights including Right to Equality (Art 14-18), Right to Freedom (Art 19-22), Right against Exploitation (Art 23-24), Right to Freedom of Religion (Art 25-28), Cultural & Educational Rights (Art 29-30), and Right to Constitutional Remedies (Art 32).

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Heart and Soul of the Constitution
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar termed Article 32 (Right to Constitutional Remedies) as the 'Heart and Soul' of the Constitution because it empowers citizens to directly approach courts.

detailed_sections.section_number_and_title: 5.2 Civic Duties, Equity, and Social Reformers
detailed_sections.full_notes: Citizenship requires active responsibility. Fundamental Duties (Part IVA, Art 51A) mandate protecting public property, environmental conservation, and national unity. Reformers like Savitribai Phule championed social equity by promoting girls' education against severe societal resistance.

margin_notes_and_sidebars.title: Equality vs Equity
margin_notes_and_sidebars.content: Equality means giving everyone the exact same resources; Equity means distributing resources based on specific needs to ensure fair and equal opportunities for all.

stem_lab_drawers.aim_or_objective: To evaluate local community compliance with Fundamental Duty Article 51A (environment and public property).
procedure_or_steps: Inspect neighborhood park, waste disposal bins, and public bus stops.
Record observations on public property upkeep, tree plantation, and littering.
Prepare a student civic recommendations report for the local Municipal Ward Councilor.
stem_lab_drawers.observations_or_results: Identifies areas where citizen awareness can improve public infrastructure care.
stem_lab_drawers.conclusion_or_principle: Civic duties require active individual effort alongside government action.

formula_calculators.formula_expression: One Individual's Right = Society's Shared Duty to Respect & Protect — Rights cannot exist in isolation without corresponding civic responsibilities.
formula_calculators.description: My right to clean air creates a duty for all citizens not to pollute.
